title: Live Telemetry Placement Validation
input_mode: Live edge/cloud /metrics endpoints and live edge-to-cloud health latency probe; no synthetic metric snapshots
interpretation: At the observed low edge utilization, all three priorities correctly remained on Edge across repeated live-metric decisions. This validates live metric acquisition and scheduler API integration under the observed healthy conditions; it does not validate overload-triggered live offload or run inference workloads.
limitations: Only one naturally observed resource condition was exercised; no live overload was induced.
No inference requests were executed as part of this milestone.
This validates current live telemetry inputs and decision path, not autonomous long-duration adaptation.
